clue.text: At least no-one pole dancing lacks energy, getting more than enough work

indicators.note: dancing sets these letters moving about into a fresh order
lacks means the shuffled pool goes without one letter

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone observes that pole dancing is hard graft, with or without much energy, for at least one performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dancing' shuffles AT LEAST NO-ONE POLE, and 'lacks energy' drops one of its three Es.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for having plenty of tasks to deal with means being overloaded with work.

clue.text: Everyone goes round company house for booze

indicators.note: goes round means the first word's letters surround the others

parts.note: everyone means all

explanation.surface: A whole firm pops round to a company residence for a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Booze is the informal word for intoxicating drink, of which this spirit is the active ingredient.

clue.text: Old party's essentially sure reputation

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party

indicators.note: essentially points to the core, the middle letters, of the word sure

explanation.surface: An old political party's reputation rests, basically, on being sure.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in good or bad odour with someone is to stand in their esteem, so it means repute.

clue.text: Painting metal rods for distribution

indicators.note: for distribution means the letters are shared out into a new order

explanation.surface: A painting, or rather a consignment of metal rods ready to be distributed.
explanation.definitionFit: A canvas by a great European artist of earlier centuries is called by this name.

clue.text: Decree there's nothing precipitate about Germany

parts.note: O, the figure zero, stands for nothing

indicators.note: about means one word wraps around the abbreviation

parts.note: to precipitate, as weather does, is to rain
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: A ruling that there's no point rushing matters concerning Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to order officially, the same as to decree something.

clue.text: Record time crossing border for objects of little worth

indicators.note: crossing means the first pair of pieces stretches across the other, holding it inside

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
an era is a period of time
a hem is the border of a garment

explanation.surface: A world record time set on a border crossing for some trivial items.
explanation.definitionFit: Ephemera are short-lived collectables such as tickets and flyers, trifles of little value.

clue.text: Room for one of Pinter's works?

definitions.meaning: room in the sense of scope or slack to move
Harold Pinter wrote dramas for the stage, such as The Birthday Party

explanation.surface: Is there room for one of Pinter's dramas?
explanation.walkthrough: Pinter also wrote a drama called The Room, which makes the first sense look like a title.
explanation.definitionFit: Slack in a rope or a joint is described as free movement, as is a stage drama.

clue.text: I'm 19 and I forced hatred

indicators.note: forced means the letters are wrenched into a new arrangement

parts.note: 19 points to the answer at 19-across, meaning remain working

explanation.surface: Someone complains of being nineteen and pushed into hating.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference brings in the six letters of 19-across, which 'forced' shuffles with I'M and I.
explanation.definitionFit: Animosity is strong hostility or ill will, a synonym for hatred.

clue.text: Country that's busy with computer network over time

indicators.note: over means one piece takes over the place of another within the word

parts.note: a busy phone line is engaged
an age is a long period of time
a LAN is a local area network of computers

explanation.surface: A nation always busy with its computer networks, around the clock.
explanation.walkthrough: In ENGAGED the network LAN takes the place of AGE, the time.
explanation.definitionFit: England is a nation of the United Kingdom, so a country.

clue.text: Bragged about Democrat getting mobbed

indicators.note: about means the boasting word goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: to crow is to boast or brag
D is the abbreviation for a Democrat in US politics

explanation.surface: A politician boasted about a Democrat being mobbed by supporters.
explanation.definitionFit: A place mobbed with people is packed and thronged.

clue.text: Trial may be exhausting, needing hotel for women

indicators.note: for means one letter stands in place of another

parts.note: wearing means tiring or exhausting
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A trial could be tiring, perhaps needing a hotel for the women involved.
explanation.definitionFit: A court case heard before a judge is called by this name, so it equals a trial.

clue.text: The girl's testing meal in hospital room for plants

parts.note: her means belonging to the girl
a barium meal is swallowed in hospital so X-rays can test the gut

explanation.surface: A girl having a test meal in hospital, in a room full of plants.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbarium is a collection of dried plant specimens, or the room or building housing them.

clue.text: Water sports or dubious activities at the outset

indicators.note: at the outset means take just the opening letter of each word

explanation.surface: Water sports, or else some shady pursuits, offered at the start of a holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Soda is short for soda water, the fizzy mixer.

clue.text: The allure of Blackpool may be slim with son going to back

indicators.note: going to back means the letter is placed at the end

parts.note: slim, as in thin or slight, can mean light

explanation.surface: A slim son heads to the back seat, seeking Blackpool's charms.
explanation.walkthrough: Blackpool is a seaside resort in north-west England famous for its autumn Illuminations, the displays that draw the crowds.
explanation.definitionFit: The Blackpool Illuminations are strings of coloured bulbs, the resort's great attraction.

clue.text: Good boys pitch for PM

parts.note: lads are boys
pitch in music is tone

explanation.surface: Some well-behaved lads pitching their case to the Prime Minister.
explanation.definitionFit: William Gladstone was a Victorian Prime Minister, four times in office.

clue.text: Wild deer, if moved outside New Zealand, must be panic-stricken

indicators.note: moved outside means the shuffled letters are placed around the abbreviation
wild means the letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Wild deer let loose outside their homeland in New Zealand would be terrified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wild' looks like the definition but is the anagram signal; the definition is 'panic-stricken'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in a frantic, out-of-control state from fear is panic-stricken.

clue.text: No rise — and debts must be scandalous

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, a rise in the land
IOUs are written acknowledgments of debts

explanation.surface: No pay rise, and mounting debts, make for a scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: Notorious means famous for something bad, much as scandalous does.

clue.text: City brothels in Kiribati protected

indicators.note: protected means the letters sit concealed inside these words

explanation.surface: Brothels in a Pacific island nation are given protection.
explanation.definitionFit: Helsinki is the capital city of Finland.

clue.text: Minister shortly to cover broadcast for large areas of America

indicators.note: to cover means the clipped word wraps around the other piece
shortly means cut the word short, losing its last letter

parts.note: a priest is a minister of religion
to air is to broadcast

explanation.surface: A minister briefly agrees to cover a broadcast about American regions.
explanation.definitionFit: The vast grasslands of the North American interior are known by this name.

clue.text: Couple without one fit moral tale

indicators.note: without means one letter is removed from the word for couple

parts.note: a pair is a couple
I is the Roman numeral for one
fit in the sense of capable means able

explanation.surface: A couple, one of whom is unwell, tell an improving story.
explanation.definitionFit: A short story told to teach a lesson, as in the Gospels, is a moral tale.

clue.text: Remain working after check

indicators.note: after means the second piece follows the first

parts.note: to stay is to check or halt
on means working, as a switched-on machine

explanation.surface: Someone stays at work after a check-up.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep going in a post beyond the expected time is to remain there.

clue.text: Universal remedy not striking a chord?

parts.note: no can mean not, as in 'no better'
to strum is to sweep the strings to sound a chord

explanation.surface: A cure-all that fails to resonate with anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Striking a chord' looks like the idiom for resonating, but is read literally as playing a guitar.
explanation.definitionFit: A nostrum is a quack medicine claimed to cure everything, a panacea.

clue.text: More work initially undertaking repairs to patio

indicators.note: initially means take the opening letter of the word undertaking
repairs to means the letters of patio are fixed into a new order

explanation.surface: More work, starting with taking on repairs to the patio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'More work' reads as extra labour but is Sir Thomas More's book.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Thomas More wrote the 1516 book describing an ideal island society.

clue.text: Right hand clenches when disregarding danger

indicators.note: clenches means the two letters grip the other word between them

parts.note: as means when, as in 'as he left'

explanation.surface: A right hand clenches into a fist when someone throws caution aside.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting impulsively without care for risk is behaving recklessly.

clue.text: Floods causing universal charges by day

indicators.note: by means the first piece is set beside the rest

parts.note: Sat is the abbreviation for Saturday
U is the film certificate for universal viewing
rates are charges or fees

explanation.surface: Floods that bring in standard daily charges for cleanup.
explanation.definitionFit: To saturate is to soak or fill completely, as floods do the land.

clue.text: City overly protective of Kentucky

indicators.note: protective of means the word wraps around the abbreviation

parts.note: too means overly, as in too kind
KY is the postal abbreviation for Kentucky

explanation.surface: A city that's overprotective of Kentucky.
explanation.definitionFit: Tokyo is the capital city of Japan.

clue.text: Make revisions to upwards trend

indicators.note: upwards in a down entry means the word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: a tide is a trend, as in the tide of opinion

explanation.surface: Revising a document to reflect a rising trend.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit is to correct or amend a text, making revisions.

clue.text: Widen pass through Scottish mountain

indicators.note: through means the second piece runs inside the first

parts.note: ben is the Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis
a pass is a road through mountains

explanation.surface: Plans to widen the pass through a Highland peak.
explanation.definitionFit: To broaden is to make wider or more extensive.

clue.text: Fool offering cheap wine and beer regularly

parts.note: plonk is British slang for cheap wine

indicators.note: regularly means take every other letter of the word beer

explanation.surface: An idiot offers bargain wine and the odd beer.
explanation.walkthrough: PLONKER is British slang for an idiot.
explanation.definitionFit: This British slang insult for a stupid person is a synonym for fool.

clue.text: Violent disturbance — charge coming after Real and Celtic played

indicators.note: coming after means the last piece goes at the end
played means the letters of the two club names are rearranged

parts.note: to storm is to charge at or attack

explanation.surface: Crowd trouble breaks out after Real Madrid and Celtic meet in a match.
explanation.walkthrough: Real (Madrid) and Celtic (of Glasgow) are football clubs; 'played' looks like part of the match report.
explanation.definitionFit: A thunderstorm with lightning is a violent atmospheric disturbance.
